diffs.diff: pin count: part has 10 (VIN 3Vo GND SCL SDA INT GND2 I2 SDO CS), datasheet reading has 9 (VIN 3V3 GND SCL SDA I1 I2 SDO CS)
diffs.evidence: The part models the STEMMA QT version of Adafruit #4097. Its pinout photo (sensors_cropped_4097-05.png) shows silkscreen 'VIN 3Vo GND SCL SDA INT' on the bottom 6-pin row and 'GND I2 SDO CS' on the top 4-pin row, which is 10 pins with a second GND. The second reading's 9 pins (VIN 3V3 GND SCL SDA SDO CS INT1 INT2, one row) match the original 2019 board photo (sensors_4097_kit_ORIG_2019_pinout.png), a different variant. The learn guide says: 'on the STEMMA QT version, pins I2 (INT2), SDO, and CS are located at the top of the board.'
